text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: RPDS/LND/09/ACQ/01/08.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Lot No. 01 allotments of below name land in total extent of about 0.0118 Hectares, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Ra. 299, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Rathnapura Town (within the Rathnapura Municipal Council limit) in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 152 B Weralupa and Minor Division of Kuruwita Korale Udapattuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Rathnapura in Rathnapura District in the Sabaragamuwa Province. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Owilanawatta; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Dickson

Dela Bandara, Nilanga Dela Bandara, Sujeewa Wijewardhana and Sudath Wijewardhana, No. 278, Colombo Road, Rathnapura; Extent: 0.0118 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Rathnapura of the 26th day of February 2016 at 2.00 p.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 19th day of February, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
C. M. . KOTTAWATTA, Divisional Secretary, Rathnapura.
